news.title: Oil prices plunge following U.S.-Iran ceasefire - Axios
news.zh: 美國伊朗停火協議後，油價暴跌
news.impact: 能源股下跌，全球油價下行，通膨壓力減輕

news.title: South Korea stocks lead gains in Asia as oil prices plunge after U.S.-Iran ceasefire deal - CNBC
news.zh: 伊朗美國停火協議後油價暴跌，韓國股市領漲亞洲
news.impact: 亞洲股市上揚，油價下跌利好經濟成長前景

news.title: Super Micro Launches Internal Probe of Server Sales to China - Bloomberg.com
news.zh: 超微電腦啟動內部調查，涉及對華伺服器銷售
news.impact: 公司信譽受損，面臨監管審查和法律風險

news.title: New Medicare Payment Rate Released. Why UnitedHealth, Humana Stocks Are Popping. - Barron's
news.zh: 新醫療保險支付費率公佈，聯合健康與慧民保險股價上漲
news.impact: 保險公司受惠於醫保費率調整，盈利前景改善

news.title: FDIC Approves Proposal to Implement GENIUS Act Requirements and Standards - Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) (.gov)
news.zh: 聯邦存款保險公司批准GENIUS法案要求和標準實施提案
news.impact: 銀行業監管規則更新，合規成本可能增加

news.title: Deere & Co agrees to pay $99 million to settle ‘right to repair’ lawsuit - AP News
news.zh: 迪爾公司同意支付9,900萬美元以解決「維修權」訴訟
news.impact: 農業機械製造商敗訴，維修權案例具有示範效應

news.title: Gilead pays $3.1B for Tubulis to bolster oncology ADC pipeline - Fierce Biotech
news.zh: 吉利德以31億美元收購圖布利斯以加強腫瘤偶聯藥物管線
news.impact: 生物製藥公司併購，oncology領域整合加速

news.title: FinCEN Proposes Rule to Fundamentally Reform Financial Institution Programs Designed to Fight Illicit Finance - FinCEN.gov
news.zh: 金融犯罪執法網絡提議規則改革金融機構反洗錢計畫
news.impact: 金融業面臨更嚴格反洗錢合規要求，成本提高

news.title: ‘All roads lead to higher prices and slower growth,' warns IMF chief as Iran war hits global economy - CNBC
news.zh: 國際貨幣基金組織總裁警告伊朗戰爭衝擊全球經濟，油價上升導致通膨和增長放緩
news.impact: 全球經濟面臨滯脹風險，股債齊跌可能性上升

news.title: Jamie Dimon warns rising oil prices could trigger a recession and a bear market in 2026 - MarketWatch
news.zh: 摩根大通執行長傑米·戴蒙警告油價上升可能觸發2026年經濟衰退和熊市
news.impact: 市場信心受挫，投資者風險偏好下降，股市承壓

news.title: Major alcohol distributor shuts down operations, lays off over 500 workers
news.zh: 主要酒類經銷商關閉營運，裁員超過500人
news.impact: 酒類供應鏈受擾，經銷商就業市場承壓

news.title: Oil Prices Rise as Iran Signals Hormuz Closure
news.zh: 伊朗示意關閉荷莫茲海峽，油價上漲
news.impact: 全球能源價格上升，地緣政治風險升溫

news.title: Petrostates Without Oil Export Routes Take the Hardest Hit
news.zh: 無石油出口路線的石油國家受創最重
news.impact: 石油國家經濟衰退，全球貿易格局受衝擊
